runs.name: compact-light
runs.prompt:
Create one individual polished raster UI design mockup for Kalyn Beach's wave-player, a compact personal local-session music player. This is a design proposal, not an implemented application. Flat orthographic screen view, crisp readable type and precise 1px rules, square structural corners, no perspective or device chassis. One coherent bounded player. Use Inter-like sans serif for content and controls, strongest text is track title; TX-02-like monospaced tabular numerals for times. Approximate these typefaces, no serif headings. Controls follow the supplied research foundations and selection screenshots: restrained neutral Base UI/shadcn buttons, thin Lucide-like utility icons, functional small-radius exceptions only. Use the supplied component captures ONLY as control style references, NEVER copy their gallery layout, navigation, calendars, specimen labels or sections. Use supplied phosphor-signal reference ONLY as the basis of a fine green repeated-trace oscilloscope within the player's visual area. It is illustrative live signal art, never album artwork or the full-track waveform. No neon control chrome, gradients, bevels, blue hardware, shadows, global grid, marketing copy, product-title hero, telemetry, WEBGPU/LIVE SIGNAL labels, card walls, scene controls, shuffle or auto-advance.
Content fixture: loaded and playing track "Low Tide", artist "North Window", album "Tidal Studies", acknowledged elapsed "01:24", duration "04:32". Title much stronger than product identity; no product name required. A separate full-track amplitude waveform is the seek control with acknowledged cursor at exactly 30.9% of its width, distinctly darker consumed portion and neutral unplayed portion; live traces have NO playhead/time axis. Transport includes practical previous, prominent Pause, next, speaker/mute, volume slider and labelled library access; buttons have generous intended hit regions. Bottom compact segmented appearance control reads "System", "Light", "Dark". Do not invent artwork or metadata. Outside the player UI, in the board's bottom margin, put exactly "Design fixture — simulated waveform and playback". Nothing in this caption belongs inside the player.
Light theme uses ground #f4f4f0, player surface #fffffc, text #171714, borders #d6d6ce, muted text still readable. Signal display is a deliberate dark forest/near-black inset with finely resolved phosphor-green traces, clean flush edges, no decorative frame. Waveform and all controls below it remain light. Light selected in appearance control.
View: compact-light. Produce ONE landscape image at approximately 1440 x 1000 viewport proportions, complete composition visible with generous plain board margin; request 1440 x 1000 pixels if supported, otherwise closest landscape size. Intended player dimensions 440 x 592 CSS pixels. Center this one player on board at that apparent scale. Anatomy: a compact top identity block with "Low Tide" in strong 28px type, "North Window" and "Tidal Studies" on a quieter single line beneath; top-right labelled "Library" button with list icon. Then a meaningful 392 x 232px oscilloscope artwork-like display inside 24px horizontal insets, fine overlapping phosphor traces with breathing space, no labels. Then a separate usable 392 x 64px full-track amplitude waveform navigation area, irregular amplitudes over whole track, acknowledged cursor at 30.9%, elapsed 01:24 lower left and duration 04:32 lower right. Below, orderly transport row with previous, square filled Pause control, next, speaker icon and volume slider. Small quiet "A/B off" button on the following utility row with System / Light / Dark appearance selector. Loop is disabled and defaults to whole track; do NOT display A/B handles or loop editor in this normal listening state. Library closed. UI should feel like a small useful music object alongside work, not a narrow dashboard. No caption headings or annotations other than required board margin fixture caption.
